initial-dialogue.npc: Oh, hello! Have you come to see the minotaurs? No one ever comes to see the minotaurs, but they love having guests!
Of course! Most people are scared of them. It's sad in a way. They're such misunderstood creatures, but they're massive softies once you get to know them!
You'll find them down in the cave if you want to say hello! They'll be thrilled to see you!

subsequent-dialogue.npc: Oh, hello again! Have you been spending time with the minotaurs? They always love it when people come to visit! Such wonderful creatures...
